subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should persona-level TTS SecretRefs land under the current fail-closed startup contract, or wait for a maintainer-approved scoped optional-TTS degradation policy?
rationale: The patch expands credential activation into an optional TTS surface, so a missing persona key can affect whole-Gateway availability; code review cannot choose that security-versus-availability boundary.

options.title: Keep strict startup
options.body: Land only after the code defects and exact-head consumer proof are addressed, accepting that a missing active persona TTS SecretRef blocks startup consistently with the current contract.

options.title: Coordinate fail-open landing
options.body: Hold this PR until the optional-TTS startup behavior in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101265 is maintainer-approved and shown compatible.

recommendation.title: Keep strict startup
recommendation.body: Land only after the code defects and exact-head consumer proof are addressed, accepting that a missing active persona TTS SecretRef blocks startup consistently with the current contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior work on TTS SecretRef runtime activation provides the strongest available ownership signal for this credential boundary.
